description: An owned queue with unique pending values, cancellation by value and oldest-first removal.

resources: stores pending values in a list; memory limits unmeasured

preconditions: Use a supported value type with equality and copy construction.
postconditions: Duplicate push returns false. A successful cancel permits reinsertion. Empty pop returns an empty optional.
effects: Push, cancel and pop change the addressed instance's pending membership.
invariants: On tested traces pending values were unique and retained FIFO order across cancellation and reinsertion.
state_protocol: Two live objects retain independent order and membership. Destroying and reconstructing one object starts it empty while the other retains its pending entries.
ownership: The tested caller owned each receiver and controlled destruction and reconstruction.
upstream_usage: The pinned test-components.cpp uses push, cancel and pop on an integer queue.
specification_question: Which supported value type and public names should the queue methods use?
